cases.notes: No broker ticket: ticket = 8e18 + (first 8 bytes of SHA-256(contentKey + "#" + occurrence), big-endian UInt64) mod 1e18, contentKey = symbol|direction|String(format:"%.8f", lots)|String(openTime.timeIntervalSince1970)|String(closeTime...)|openPrice.description|closePrice.description|netProfit.description; occurrence counts identical keys within one file (0, 1, ...). Two identical rows are two trades. Derived tickets are strings (beyond JS safe integers); keys: EURUSD|BUY|0.10000000|1770022800.0|1770026400.0|1.08|1.082|20#0 ; GBPUSD|SELL|0.20000000|1770123600.0|1770129000.0|1.27|1.271|-20#0 ; GBPUSD|SELL|0.20000000|1770123600.0|1770129000.0|1.27|1.271|-20#1
